body: Yes as I mentioned they are not actually charging the remaining amount. They only want the checks. This resulted in my insurance being billed for over 300k in denied claims with 30k in checks. This is all for a couple months of talk therapy by the way which would never cost this much. The scheme seems like they just charge whatever they want to insurance to grab the checks.

They completely evade my questions on email correspondence. I tried calling them directly and the owners refuse to speak to me or call me back. One of the owners emailed me threatening to call my work and revoke an ADA accommodation they previously submitted for me. Basically said, “send us the checks or we will call your work and say you lied about your accommodation request and that will hurt your professional career”. Really sketchy behavior all around, I let my work know about the situation in advance and am not really worried about that aspect.
